I understand. I'm ready to help you explore your homelab codebase and design implementation plans. This is a read-only planning session - I will only use tools to read and explore the codebase, never to modify anything.

I can see from the git status that you're working on a homelab project with:
- OpenTofu (Terraform) infrastructure code
- Some pending changes to dashboard services and IP registry
- New work on obsidian-sync and traefik routes

What would you like me to help you plan or explore?
